S6931.reason: The absolute /.well-known metadata and /oauth authorization routes have protocol-defined paths that cannot share a controller prefix.

S6932.reason: GetMetadata reads X-Forwarded-Proto and Request.Host to publish the external authorization-server URLs behind the proxy. GetProtectedResourceMetadata reads X-Forwarded-Proto and Request.Host to publish the external MCP resource and authorization-server URLs. BuildGoogleRedirectUri reads X-Forwarded-Proto and Request.Host for the externally reachable OAuth callback URI.

HandleWebhook preserves the raw Stripe body and Stripe-Signature header for webhook signature verification before dispatch. HandlePlayNotification validates the Authorization push token before forwarding the raw RTDN body to the handler.

ORBIT0004.reason: The since guard measures the elapsed MaxSyncWindow against the UTC sync cursor; it does not choose a calendar day. SyncChangesV2Response.ServerTimestamp is the UTC synchronization cursor used for subsequent incremental reads.

CreateCode stamps AuthorizationEntry.CreatedAt for the authorization code TTL, independently of the user timezone. ExchangeCode compares elapsed time since AuthorizationEntry.CreatedAt with CodeExpiry before accepting a code. Cleanup evicts authorization codes whose CreatedAt instant precedes the CodeExpiry cutoff.

S107.reason: LogRateLimitRejected maps each policy, partition, count, retry, method, path and request id to its own generated structured-log placeholder.

ORBIT0004.reason: Handle compares elapsed seconds since VerificationEntry.CreatedAt to enforce the 60-second code resend cooldown. Handle stamps the randomized verification code issuance instant for cooldown checks; the cache TTL is separate. TrySeedTestAccountCode stamps the configured test code issuance instant, with a separate 30-minute cache TTL. TrySeedProductionSmokeCode stamps the smoke code issuance instant, with a separate 30-minute cache TTL.
MarkDismissed records DismissedAtUtc as an audit instant; the suggestion has no dismissal calendar-date policy.
MarkImported records the same ImportedAtUtc audit instant for every matched calendar suggestion in this import.
The lastSentAt comparison enforces a 60-second waitlist email resend interval against a cached UTC instant.

CS0649.reason: EF materializes _resolvedAtUtc through the configured ResolvedAtUtc backing field; SQL ExecuteUpdate resolves the row without a C# field assignment.

S3459.reason: The _resolvedAtUtc field must remain mapped and writable by EF for atomic clarification resolution; absence of a C# assignment does not mean it is unused.

CS0649.reason: EF materializes retained report _reviewedAtUtc through the configured ReviewedAtUtc backing field; the persisted review stamp has no C# assignment.

S3459.reason: The retained Report.ReviewedAtUtc property reads _reviewedAtUtc from EF materialization, so the private field cannot be removed as unassigned.

ORBIT0004.reason: AiUsageDaily.Date partitions model cost counters by UTC accounting day; it is not the user quota or schedule date.

GetUsersScheduledForDeletionAsync compares ScheduledDeletionAt with the current instant to find expired deletion grace periods. CleanupStaleSentRecords uses a 90-day UTC retention boundary for old reminder and slip-alert dedupe rows, not notification scheduling. processedRequestCutoff expires ProcessedRequests by elapsed retention days against CreatedAtUtc.

cooldownBoundary bounds CreatedAtUtc by StepUpChallengeCooldownSeconds to throttle issuance of another step-up challenge. CanVerify checks the step-up challenge ExpiresAtUtc TTL and attempt limit against the current instant.
yesterday selects the UTC AiUsageDaily accounting partition and operator quota summary log; user scheduling and quota enforcement do not consume it.

CreateSessionAsync computes the refresh-token ExpiresAtUtc instant through GetRefreshExpiry; no calendar date is derived. RefreshSessionAsync uses nowUtc for CanUse validity, refresh expiry and Rotate audit stamps, all session instants. HasSessionForTokenAsync compares ExpiresAtUtc with nowUtc to reject expired refresh tokens.

RecordTick stores a UTC liveness instant in LastSuccessfulTicks for background-service monitoring. CheckHealthAsync subtracts the last liveness instant to report elapsed minutes and detect a stale service.
streakWindowStart widens the batched log prefetch by a timezone-skew day; ComputeReadValue receives the separately converted userToday.

expiresAt falls back to the current UTC instant when Play provides no subscription expiry; it remains an absolute expiry value. The isActive check compares the Play expiry instant with the current UTC instant, independently of calendar dates.
ConservativeCutoffUtc is the widened stale-habit prefetch floor; ShouldAdvanceForUserToday checks the separately converted userToday before mutation.
SecurityTokenDescriptor.Expires is the JWT absolute expiry instant computed from the configured token lifetime.
TryConsumeFreshConfirmation passes the current instant to IsUsable to check confirmation and step-up TTLs before consumption.
GetForResolutionAsync compares ExpiresAtUtc with now to exclude expired clarification operations without selecting a user date.
playCutoff removes processed Play notification dedupe entries by ProcessedAtUtc retention age. stripeCutoff removes processed Stripe event dedupe entries by ProcessedAtUtc retention age.
utcDate anchors widened end-date, sent-week and history prefetch floors; ProcessHabitSlipAlertAsync chooses the send day and dedupe week from converted userToday.
BillingSubscriptionDetails.CurrentPeriodEnd falls back to the current instant when the Stripe item is missing; it is an expiry timestamp.

cutoff removes sync tombstones by elapsed RetentionPeriod against DeletedAtUtc, independently of user calendar dates. suggestionCutoff removes unimported calendar suggestions by DiscoveredAtUtc age after SuggestionRetentionPeriod.

UpdateHabit preserves nine flat habit update schema properties, including intervalWeeks and emoji.
